hypothesis: A row-local Bayesian current-season pitcher state should carry the changing league level, while a small season-centered CatBoost RMSE residual learns only stable contextual deviations and avoids a stale global intercept.

legality.state_inputs: current row official as-of counters minus pre-season frozen train state

model.family: CatBoostRegressor RMSE on season-centered y minus state_base
model.drop_features: same V3 C overall-Trackman drop list plus pitcher_id

selection.route: R only; F remains each comparison baseline unchanged
selection.eligibility: positive R point gain and positive pitcher-cluster 95% R gain lower bound in every development-year/comparison cell
selection.ranking: largest minimum R point gain across all cells, then smaller gamma, then variant name
selection.failure_rule: if no eligible variant, do not fit or read a 2024 candidate

confirmation.requirements: positive point and 95% lower gain against exact parent and both honest anchors
confirmation.completion: V5 validation contract v2 conservative lower score and all package gates
